label: R&B / Soul
blueprintGuidance: Represent R&B and soul: groove pocket, smooth harmony, vocal phrasing, and intimate emotional control.
Keep the hook warm, repeatable, and rhythmically relaxed.
Use mood input for late-night, sensual, lonely, or bittersweet color.
generationGuidance: Use electric piano, warm sub or electric bass, tight low-volume drums, snaps, soft pads, and sparse guitar accents.
Keep the rhythm pocketed with subtle syncopation and smooth bass movement.
Use tasteful harmony layers at hook emphasis points while keeping the lead vocal forward.
Add small ad-lib responses near the final repeat only.
avoidGuidance: Avoid trap-dominant hi-hat rolls, aggressive 808 slides, and club energy.
Avoid rock guitars, cinematic strings, and bright pop leads.
